videos.title: Breaking the eShop: An Interview with Michael Flarup
videos.description:
This week on NPC: Next Portable Console, Federico and John are joined by Michael Flarup, the founder of Northplay, the game studio behind Conduct This!, Conduct Together!, and the upcoming Dinolords to discuss his career as a game, graphic, and app designer.


Then on NPC XL, for Patreon supporters, Michael Flarup joins Federico and John to talk about his handheld videogame collection and app, Cibby, for tracking his collection.
